项目介绍 ​

提供直观的页面级可视化配置能力，也能够将已配置的图表和仪表盘分享嵌入至其他SaaS应用中。

SDK属性 ​

参数说明类型默认值
uid分享面板share_uidString''
apiPrefixsdk内ajax请求 api 前缀，比如请求mysql 数据，/api/v1/datasource/query/,:api-prefix ='a',则请求地址为：a/api/v1/datasource/query/String''
timeRange面板筛选变量默认时间范围Array['now/d', 'now/d']
filter面板筛选变量，{name:1,name2:2}，Object{}
waterMark水印内容Object{}
isFullScroll默认面板将100%充满容器，工具栏固定，此值为false，整个面板将会在容器内滚动Booleantrue
isShowTools是否展示面板上的工具栏，值为false是，工具栏将不展示，工具栏的工具展示属性（如：）配置无效Booleantrue
isShowRefresh是否展示面板上的工具栏，值为false是，工具栏将不展示，工具栏的工具展示属性（如：）配置无效Booleantrue
isShowTimeRange是否展示时间查询组件Booleantrue

SDK 使用说明 ​

bk-vision 分别支持vue 组件迁入与 纯js引入

  • 纯js-sdkbk-vision-app
  • 以及vue组件sdkbk-vision-vue.

bk-vision-vue （暂未发布，请参考内部版@tencent/bk-vision-app) ​

注意事项 ​

：@blueking/cli-service-webpack4(老版bk-cli模板工程，无法使用npm形式。) 推荐使用 @blueking/cli-service-webpack5 与vue-cli 等构建工具

项目中使用 ​

vue
<bk-dashboard
  :filter='{}'
  :waterMark='{content: ["bk-vision"]}'
  :timeRange='["now/d", "now/d"]'
  uid='FwchfLZSsoaBSzjpW7WBa7'
  api-prefix='http://127.0.0.1:8001/bkvision/'/>
tsx
import { defineComponent } from 'vue';
import { DashboardVue } from '@/dashboard-vue';

export default defineComponent({
  name: 'Preview',
  setup() {
    return () => (
      <div class="full-height">
        <DashboardVue
          uid="ZKBEWuc9ar3yydWKPSwVGv"
          filter={{ 2222333333333: '3' }}
          apiPrefix="/bkvision/"
        />
      </div>
    );
  },
});

完整案例

vue
<template>
  <div class="home" style='width: 100%;height:1000px;'>
    <bk-dashboard
      :filter='{}'
      :waterMark='{content: ["bk-vision"]}'
      :timeRange='["now/d", "now/d"]'
      uid='FwchfLZSsoaBSzjpW7WBa7'
      api-prefix="/bkvision/"/>
  </div>
</template>

<script>
import BkDashboard from '@tencent/bk-vision-vue'
import '@tencent/bk-vision-vue/dist/main.css'

export default {
  name: 'Sdk',
  components: {
    BkDashboard,
  },
};
</script>

bk-vision-vue 组件属性 ​

bk-vision-vue 组件属性说明

tsx
/**
 * 项目打包成vue组件入口
 */

import Dashboard from '@/pages/Dashboard';
import { computed, defineComponent, PropType, App, Plugin, watch } from 'vue';
import { ShareFormData } from '@/typings';
import { TimeRangeType } from '@/components/time-range';
import http from '@/api/http';

const DashboardVue = defineComponent({
  name: 'DashboardVue',
  props: {
    uid: {
      type: String,
      default: '',
      required: true,
    },
    filter: {
      type: Object as PropType<Record<string, any>>,
      default: () => ({}),
    },
    waterMark: {
      type: Object as PropType<Record<string, any>>,
      default: () => ({}),
    },
    timeRange: {
      type: Object as PropType<TimeRangeType>,
      default: () => ['now/d', 'now/d'],
    },
    apiPrefix: String,
  },
  setup(props) {
    watch(() => props.apiPrefix, (url) => {
      http.defaults.baseURL = url;
    }, { immediate: true });
    const shareData = computed(() => {
      const [start_time, end_time] = props.timeRange ?? [];
      return {
        ...new ShareFormData(),
        uid: props.uid,
        start_time,
        end_time,
      };
    });

    return {
      shareData,
    };
  },
  render() {
    return (
      <Dashboard shareData={this.shareData} shareType="sdk" />
  );
  },
});
const DashboardVuePlugin: Plugin = {
  install(app: App) {
    app.component('DashboardVuePlugin', DashboardVue);
  },
};
export { DashboardVue };
export default DashboardVuePlugin;

内部版使用 ​

内部版为 @tencent/bk-vision-vue

@tencent/bk-vision-vue 安装 ​

参考

shell
tnpm i @tencent/bk-vision-vue

内部版使用 ​

只是报名增加 @tencent/

javascript
import '@tencent/bk-vision-vue'
import '@tencent/bk-vision-vue/dist/main.css'

tnpm无法安装，可以使用git引用 ​

json
{
  "dependencies": {
    "bk-vision-vue": "git+https://github.com/bk-vision/bk-vision-vue"
  }
}
